title: Briakos scientific-scope reconstruction: explicit support semantics versus unresolved total-count claim

primary_source_method_evidence.source: Nikolaos Briakos, An Undeciphered Script in the Age of AI: A Corpus-Constrained Computational Analysis of Linear A, MSc thesis, University of Piraeus, May 2026

observations.fact: The thesis states that transliteratedWords is the analysis field and translatedWords is not used.
It reports 419 total tablets, 336 with syllabic content, 2481 sign tokens, 65 sign types, 1244 word tokens, 573 word types, entropy 5.5826 bits, hapax 434/573, mean word length 1.99.
It explicitly defines the two primary support types as clay tablets (administrative) and stone vessels (ceremonial), with 299 clay tablets / 2139 sign tokens and 37 stone vessels / 342 sign tokens.

predeclared_scope_hypothesis.basis: Directly stated thesis support semantics and published register counts; not chosen from target search.
predeclared_scope_hypothesis.effective_source_view: JavaScript-Map-compatible effective document view from admitted loader v0.4
predeclared_scope_hypothesis.content_condition: At least one retained token under the already-frozen THESIS_LITERAL_ALPHA_v0.1 tokenizer.
predeclared_scope_hypothesis.total_scope_probe: support in allowed_support_values_exact regardless of content; diagnostic only

decision_rule.scientific_scope_reconstructed: All content/register/token/type targets match at published precision under the predeclared explicit-support content scope.
decision_rule.total_count_reconstructed: The diagnostic exact-support union regardless of content equals 419 without further filtering.
decision_rule.partial_reconstruction: Scientific scope matches but total-count claim does not; preserve 419 as unresolved methodological count and do not search for a post-hoc 419 subset.
decision_rule.negative: Scientific scope targets diverge; report all divergences and do not alter the support rule in this run.

contamination_firewall.reason: The frozen hypothesis uses only Briakos' own explicit Tablet/Stone vessel support semantics. The MDP LEDGER support union differs because it adds Lames and multi-sided bars and excludes Stone vessel.
